title: Annual climate indicators and warming trend by city, 1951-2025
description:
Annual climate indicators for 1951-2025 for the largest cities (frost days, hot days, tropical nights, temperature anomaly, warmest-year rank) and the warming trend, computed from the daily ERA5-Land values.

Columns. tmean_c (°C), tmean_anomaly_c (°C), precip_mm (mm), precip_anomaly_pct (%), wet_days, heavy_rain_days, max_1day_precip_mm (mm), frost_days, ice_days, summer_days, hot_days, tropical_nights (days), tmax_abs_c (°C), tmin_abs_c (°C), degree days hdd_15_5, hdd_18, cdd_18, cdd_22 (°C·day), rank_warmest. Trend columns in the cities file: tmean_annual_c, precip_annual_mm, trend_c_per_decade_1951_2025, trend_c_per_decade_1981_2025, warmest_year, coldest_year, wettest_year, driest_year.

Method. Copernicus ERA5-Land hourly reanalysis, 0.1° grid, nearest cell to the city point, local civil days (IANA time zone, complete days only). Temperatures are adjusted for altitude at 6.5 °C per km; precipitation is not adjusted.

Limits. Grid-cell reanalysis values, not station measurements. Hot days in city centres are undercounted. Degree days differ from figures published by national services.

Places. Cities from GeoNames (cities5000), CC BY 4.0, ranked by population: 100 each for the UK, Germany and France, 20 each for Portugal and Serbia, 5 for Luxembourg; city_id is the GeoNames id. Files are named <cc>_... per country (gb, de, fr, pt, lu, rs).
